deployment_path.description: Where its canonical folder now lives.

linked_harnesses.description:
Harnesses that now see the skill through a per-skill link or a
whole-folder link into the shared folder.

harness_results.description: What happened for each requested harness, in request order.

oneOf.description:
`trust_identity` was set, is not yet trusted, and `trust_confirmed`
was `false`. Nothing was written; retry with `trust_confirmed: true`
once the user confirms.

identity.description: The normalized identity that needs confirming.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `open-code`.

Invariant: the string is the serde wire name used by the desktop app
today. `open-code` is canonical; `opencode` is only a CLI binary name and
is never stored in an `AgentId`.

InstallHarnessResult.description: What `install` did for one requested harness.

oneOf.description:
The harness reads the skill from the shared folder at `path`, either
directly or because its own folder is a link to the shared folder.

path.description: The skill folder the harness reads.

oneOf.description: A relative symlink at `path` points to the shared folder's copy.

link_failed.description:
`true` when a link was asked for but the symlink failed, so the
folder was copied instead.

oneOf.description: Nothing was written for this harness.
